description: Manifest of checkpoints for the three core logics in tech_spec.md. Each entry points at one test method in one test file. Run with: python tests/run_checkpoints.py

checkpoints.title: Run rate is units divided by observation hours
checkpoints.description: Shopee worked example from tech_spec §10: 9 units over a 7-day window is 0.0535714 units/hour.

checkpoints.title: Run rate on a slow channel
checkpoints.description: TikTok worked example: 2 units over 168 hours is 0.0119048 units/hour.

checkpoints.title: Hours to stock-out, Shopee
checkpoints.description: 12 allocated units at 0.0535714/hour runs dry in exactly 224 hours (~9.3 days).

checkpoints.title: Hours to stock-out, TikTok
checkpoints.description: 130 allocated units at 0.0119048/hour is 10920 hours, showing a slow channel has huge cover.

checkpoints.title: Zero observation hours is rejected
checkpoints.description: A zero-length window must raise rather than divide by zero.

checkpoints.title: Zero run rate never divides by zero
checkpoints.description: A dormant SKU returns None for hours-to-stock-out instead of raising ZeroDivisionError.

checkpoints.title: Zero allocation is already out of stock
checkpoints.description: Allocated 0 units resolves to OUT_OF_STOCK, not DORMANT and not HEALTHY.

checkpoints.title: AT_RISK when stock runs out inside the horizon
checkpoints.description: Cover below the alert horizon is flagged AT_RISK.

checkpoints.title: HEALTHY when cover exceeds the horizon
checkpoints.description: Cover beyond the alert horizon is not flagged.

checkpoints.title: DORMANT when the SKU has no sales
checkpoints.description: No sales yields DORMANT rather than a false AT_RISK from a zero rate.

checkpoints.title: Reallocation recommends the worked-example quantity
checkpoints.description: Shopee needs 6 units; TikTok can spare 126. The recommendation is 6 units.

checkpoints.title: A move never exceeds the donor's surplus
checkpoints.description: Property: the recommended quantity is always <= donor_surplus, so the donor keeps target cover.

checkpoints.title: No recommendation when the donor has no surplus
checkpoints.description: A donor below target cover yields None, which the UI must render as 'no donor available'.

checkpoints.title: A transfer preserves total allocation
checkpoints.description: Migration is a transfer, not an increase, so total allocated units must be unchanged and can never exceed stock on hand.

checkpoints.title: Seller receipt is net of commission, payment and admin fee
checkpoints.description: Shopee worked example: Rp 12,240 net at 8% + 2% + Rp 1,250/34 yields Rp 10,979.235 per unit.

checkpoints.title: Variable rate is the sum of the percentage fees
checkpoints.description: commission + payment + affiliate, with the fixed admin fee excluded.

checkpoints.title: The admin fee does not scale with price
checkpoints.description: A fixed per-order fee hurts cheap orders more than expensive ones, so the receipt gap widens as price falls.

checkpoints.title: TikTok affiliate commission reduces the receipt
checkpoints.description: The 5% affiliate rate makes TikTok's receipt lower than an otherwise identical Shopee order.

checkpoints.title: Zero units is rejected
checkpoints.description: A per-unit receipt cannot be computed with no units; must raise.

checkpoints.title: Under-COGS per unit
checkpoints.description: Worked example: cost Rp 12,050 less receipt Rp 10,979.235 is Rp 1,070.765 of loss per unit.

checkpoints.title: Under-COGS total
checkpoints.description: Rp 1,070.765 per unit across 34 units is Rp 36,406 of total loss.

checkpoints.title: Severity is AT_RISK at 8.9% of cost
checkpoints.description: A loss under 10% of cost sits in AT_RISK, not CRITICAL.

checkpoints.title: Severity is CRITICAL above 10% of cost
checkpoints.description: Band boundary is expressed against cost, not against price.

checkpoints.title: Severity is WATCH when thin but still profitable
checkpoints.description: A profitable SKU with margin between -5% and 0% is a warning, not a loss.

checkpoints.title: Target price recovers cost, margin and fees
checkpoints.description: Worked example yields Rp 15,438, grossing up for the variable rate and adding the fixed admin fee.

checkpoints.title: Target price always exceeds unit cost
checkpoints.description: Property: for a non-negative target margin the corrected price must be above cost, else the fix does not fix anything.

checkpoints.title: Gross exposure counts only losses
checkpoints.description: A profitable SKU must not offset a loss, because profit elsewhere does not restore a depleted reserve.

checkpoints.title: Net position lets profits offset losses
checkpoints.description: The reporting view, which may be negative; must differ from gross exposure when profits exist.

checkpoints.title: Budget safe subtracts exposure from the campaign budget
checkpoints.description: Worked example: Rp 50,000,000 budget less Rp 18,400,000 exposure leaves Rp 31,600,000.

checkpoints.title: Budget remaining percentage
Status HEALTHY when most of the reserve survives
checkpoints.description: More than half the reserve intact is HEALTHY.

checkpoints.title: Status CAUTION when over half the reserve is consumed
checkpoints.description: Between zero and half remaining is CAUTION.

checkpoints.title: Status BREACHED when the reserve is exhausted
checkpoints.description: Zero or negative remaining is BREACHED.

checkpoints.title: Exactly half remaining is CAUTION, not HEALTHY
checkpoints.description: Boundary behaviour: the HEALTHY band is strictly greater than half, so the boundary itself is CAUTION.

checkpoints.title: Zero campaign budget is rejected
checkpoints.description: A percentage of nothing is meaningless, and it guards against an AM typo scaling the whole guardrail.

checkpoints.title: A 1-hour horizon cannot predict at realistic rates
checkpoints.description: Pinned limitation from tech_spec §6.4: at 0.0139 units/hour, one allocated unit takes ~72 hours to clear, so a 1-hour horizon returns HEALTHY. This checkpoint exists so nobody 'fixes' the finding away.

checkpoints.title: A 7-day horizon does predict at the same rate
checkpoints.description: Pinned workaround: the identical formula with a 168-hour horizon returns AT_RISK, proving only the threshold moves, not the maths.

checkpoints.title: The fastest SKU in the fixture is far below hourly velocity
checkpoints.description: Pinned measurement: the fixture's fastest channel runs at 0.0139 units/hour, two orders of magnitude below what an hourly alert needs. Recorded so the fixture's sparsity is never mistaken for a logic bug.

checkpoints.title: The default alert horizon is still 1 hour
checkpoints.description: Pins the default horizon at 1.0 per tech_spec §9. Added after mutation testing showed that changing this default broke nothing, because every other checkpoint passes the horizon explicitly - meaning a silent change would bypass the §6.4 finding entirely.
